name: Rolex
verdict: Owned by Rolex SA, which is held by the Hans Wilsdorf Foundation, a private trust. Nothing found.
note: Rolex logo shown on the Legion XIII team page partner bar; Jon Rahm is a Rolex Testimonee since 2016 (rolex.com). Rated none 2026-10-03: same foundation-owned chain as tudor (rolex-sa-record); private trust, no state owner.
